eligibility_criteria.domicile_ncr_rule: Punjab permanent residence/domicile required across Punjab districts; non-Punjab residents excluded.
eligibility_criteria.age_range: As per scheme rules / age eligibility criteria
eligibility_criteria.income_cap: Per official department notification / income slab criteria
eligibility_criteria.academic_or_work_rules: As specified in official scheme notification
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Applicants not meeting statutory residency/income/category rules or claiming overlapping benefit

benefit.summary_hi: सेवा केंद्र से वरिष्ठ नागरिक कार्ड द्वारा 60+ पुरुषों को सरकारी बस किराये में 50% छूट एवं निःशुल्क वृद्धाश्रम सुविधा।
benefit.summary_en: Senior Citizen ID card via Sewa Kendra granting 50% PRTC/Punjab Roadways bus fare concession (men 60+) + free state old age homes.

benefit_summary.en: Senior Citizen ID card via Sewa Kendra granting 50% PRTC/Punjab Roadways bus fare concession (men 60+) + free state old age homes.

application_steps.offline: Submit verified documents at nearest Sewa Kendra / Connect Punjab (esewa.punjab.gov.in) & 1076 Doorstep Delivery
application_steps.facilitation_center: Sewa Kendra / Connect Punjab (esewa.punjab.gov.in) & 1076 Doorstep Delivery

anti_dalal.official_fee: ₹0 (Official government portal application is free unless statutory challan is notified)
anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_hi: पंजाब सेवा केंद्र पर केवल आधिकारिक RTS शुल्क रसीद के साथ दें
anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_en: Punjab Sewa Kendra statutory RTS facilitation fee with printed acknowledgement slip only
anti_dalal.receipt_rule: Always collect your official Acknowledgement Slip & Reference Number after submission. Never pay without a printed receipt.
anti_dalal.middleman_warning: Never pay agents/middlemen promising guaranteed approval or faster clearance. Benefits are disbursed strictly via DBT / official portals.
